title: EXA_Ingestion_Adapter_Schema
description: The one normalized shape every per-source adapter must produce before an event is admitted to the aggregated override log (Step 4 §4.4, Step 5 §6.1). Consumes exa.constraint.id / exa.constraint.version / exa.surface.id verbatim from Q-019/D-033. v1.1 adds exa_constraint_class per the Q-034 ruling (D-065): one universal routing key, one discriminator field, no parallel ID namespaces. Source: EXA_AgenticWorkflow_Step8_RatifiedSourceImplementationDetail_v1.4.md §2.3a.

exa_constraint_id.description: Required. The single universal routing key for ANY ratified specification object governing agentic execution — a state constraint, a Generative Envelope, a Vendor Envelope, or a Generative Vendor Envelope. Per Q-034 (D-065), a Generative Envelope's identity resolves an exa_constraint_id at the enforcement plane; envelope_id is its authoring-plane form, not a parallel key. Must resolve to an existing ratified object. Never inferred or backfilled by the adapter — see the validation table in docs/adapter-validation-rules.md.

exa_constraint_class.description: Required. The authoring-plane type of the object exa_constraint_id resolves to. Added per Q-034 (D-065). This field carries object-type information WITHOUT fracturing the routing key: every consumer still joins on exa_constraint_id alone and may filter on class, rather than joining across disparate namespaces. Extensible — a new governed object class adds an enum value here, never a new ID field.

exa_constraint_version.description: Optional at ingestion; if absent, resolves to the object's current certified version at aggregation time.

exa_surface_id.description: Optional at ingestion for Jira-originated events, since a manually filed override may not always carry a resolvable surface ID; required for CI/CD- and gateway-originated events, where the surface is always known structurally.

event_type.description: v1.1 adds two values per Q-034's amendment pass. 'clarification' admits the Agent Clarification Log (A-15) that Step 4 §2.5 mandates as machine-captured telemetry — closing F-01. 'containment_discard' admits Step 7 §4.3's DISCARD_AND_REPROMPT Containment State invocations, which Step 7 §4.3a (D-056) requires be metered as retry cycles against SS-1.

squad_id.description: Required. Must identify a specific submitting squad, not a shared or default value — see the validation table in docs/adapter-validation-rules.md for why this is load-bearing.

native_payload_ref.description: Pointer to the original Jira ticket ID, CI job ID, or Agent Clarification Log entry. Not consumed by any trigger-evaluation logic — carried strictly for auditability, so a Structural Signal finding can be traced back to its originating filings.
